pkgmetadata.longdescription: FreeUnit is the community-maintained LTS fork of NGINX Unit (archived by F5 in October 2025). A dynamic multi-language web application server: runs PHP (and other runtimes) applications plus static assets in a single runtime, configured via a REST API with live reloads. This build provides the core unitd daemon plus PHP application modules for selected dev-lang/php slots. FreeUnit is a drop-in replacement for www-servers/nginx-unit: same unitd binary, paths and user; the two packages block each other.
